item.title: ‘Blade’ Director Says ‘Sinners’ Was “So Much Bolder” Than What Marvel Was Attempting & “Life’s Too Short To Make Sh*t Films”
item.description: If you thought “ Blade ”-gate had died down and director Bassam Tariq had already said his piece about Marvel’ s troubled reboot, guess again. The filmmaker, originally hired to direct “Blade” with Mahershala Ali in the title role, opened up again about his frustrating experience at Marvel Studios, revealing that the production began casting actors without a proper screenplay. The experience ultimately taught him a valuable lesson: “Life’s too short to make shit films.” Speaking in a new interview with The New Arab, Tariq offered an unusually candid account of his Marvel experience, perhaps speaking more freely given the relatively low-profile outlet, as he described the strange circumstances of developing a major studio production without a finished screenplay.
